reference_wholesale_price_description: Calendar-day weighted 2020 Ofgem Annex 2 direct-fuel electricity index before supplier uplifts and losses (55.250087 Jan-Mar, 50.676101 Apr-Sep, 42.418445 Oct-Dec GBP/MWh).
annualisation: Annualised 2020 direct-debit single-rate values. Standing charges use each period's annual nil charge divided by 365 and the actual 2020 days (91, 183, 92); energy charges use a uniform annual consumption profile over the 366-day leap year.
limitations: This is an annualised historical snapshot, not an individual statutory cap-period rate table.
The counterfactual changes only the direct electricity commodity price. It is not a statutory price-cap calculation.
Only direct-debit single-rate electricity is currently populated for this historical snapshot.
